name: memnoth
description: Local-first bi-temporal memory vault and code graph, served over MCP by the Memnoth CLI.
long_description: Memnoth keeps durable memory in a local SQLite vault and indexes code graphs per workspace. This bundle runs the real Memnoth CLI as a stdio MCP server against the vault you choose at install time. Nothing leaves your machine unless you supply an optional hosted token. Three representative tools are declared below; the server exposes additional mem_* and kg_* tools at runtime.

tools.name: mem_stats
tools.description: Vault counters: current and total entities, relations and observations.

tools.name: kg_status
tools.description: Code graph staleness and generation counters for a workspace.

tools.name: mem_search
tools.description: Search the memory vault by relevance: ranked entities with the best-matching fact text for each hit.

vault.title: Vault file
vault.description: Path to the local Memnoth vault SQLite database the server should open. Defaults to the per-machine vault. The parent directory must already exist; Memnoth does not create it.

mcp_token.title: Hosted MCP token (optional)
mcp_token.description: Optional bearer token for hosted Memnoth MCP features. Leave empty for local-only use. The host masks and stores this value securely (OS keychain where available); Memnoth never writes it to its config.
